Subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification — GPU type & throughput targets

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from Redwood and a few follow-ups we committed to: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Estimated monthly token volume: ~6B tokens/month (typical day ~200M; peak days up to ~350M)
- Models: customer-run 3B-parameter chat+completion model (8k context), unbatched request mix: 70% short completions, 30% long multi-turn sessions
- Latency target: P95 < 350ms for interactive flows
- High-level budget range you mentioned: $40k–$60k/month for dedicated inference
- Unit economics goal you mentioned on call: target $/1M tokens in the low double-digits (you said 8–12 $/1M as a target)

Action items Marissa/Redwood promised:
1) Ballpark cost estimates for A100 vs H100 reserved pools and example $/1M tokens at 2, 4, and 8 GPU configs.
2) Throughput/per-GPU targets we should design against based on your workload profile.
3) Notes on burst capacity/autoscaling and typical procurement lead times.

Attaching the preliminary pricing workbook and our SOC 2 report for procurement. Marcus will follow up with sizing/pricing assumptions by EOD Monday. Let me know if I missed anything.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: ACME_dedicated_pricing_v1.xlsx; SOC2_report_redwood.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification — GPU type & throughput targets

Hi Sam / Marissa — following up with the sizing and ballpark economics based on the numbers from the call. Assumptions: model = 3B params, FP16 or 8-bit quantization supported, 8k context average request length ~600 tokens, peak concurrency ~180 concurrent requests.

Per-GPU throughput (observed on Redwood benchmarks):
- A100 (80GB, FP16): ~1200–1400 tokens/sec for this model (8k context)
- H100 (80GB, FP16/AMP): ~2000–2300 tokens/sec (higher for optimized kernels)
- A10 (40GB): ~600–800 tokens/sec (cost-effective but lower throughput)

Recommended reserved configs for 6B tokens/month (approx):
- 2 x H100: sustained throughput ~4.5k tokens/sec; estimated capacity ~4–5B tokens/month (with conservative batching/kv cache)
- 4 x H100: sustained throughput ~9k tokens/sec; estimated capacity ~9–10B tokens/month (comfortable for peaks)
- 4 x A100: sustained throughput ~5k tokens/sec; estimated capacity ~5–6B tokens/month (cheaper than 4xH100 but higher latency)

Ballpark monthly pricing (list-style committed / example only):
- H100 reserved (per GPU): $21,000 / month
- A100 reserved (per GPU): $9,500 / month
- A10 reserved (per GPU): $3,000 / month

Effective unit economics (very rough):
- 4 x H100 pool (monthly cost $84k): with 9B tokens/month capacity -> ~$9.3 per 1M tokens
- 4 x A100 pool (monthly cost $38k): with 5.5B tokens/month capacity -> ~$6.9 per 1M tokens
- 2 x H100 pool (monthly cost $42k): with 4.5B tokens/month capacity -> ~$9.3 per 1M tokens (similar due to headroom)

Notes/considerations:
- These numbers assume typical batching and KV cache efficiency; your request mix (many short completions) will increase per-token cost slightly vs fully batched throughput.
- H100 gives better latency headroom and is preferable if p95 latency needs to be tight under burst.
- We can design a mixed pool (A100 for baseline, H100 for burst region) and an automated fallback policy.

Next steps: if you confirm target monthly spend and appetite for H100 vs A100, we can produce a two-option formal quote + SOW for procurement.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Park <sam.park@acme-analytics.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification — GPU type & throughput targets

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Our estimate was 6B tokens/month as a mid-case (agree with your capacity calc for 4x A100). Peak days skew higher on product launches.
- Procurement budget: we have flexibility up to $60k/month for the first committed term; target unit economics we'd like to see is max $10/1M tokens (our internal target).
- Preference: trial a 4-GPU A100 pool to validate latency/cost, with the option to scale to H100 for peak traffic or high-concurrency windows.

Can you provide a 12-month committed pricing option and a short SOW that lists: reserved GPUs, expected steady-state throughput, burst policy, and SLAs? Procurement also asked for SOC2 and network architecture diagram (we received SOC2, will send diagram if you have it).

Sam
Head of ML Platform, Acme Analytics
